cases.explain: The preposition против (against) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: They will fall by the sword.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Мы не скажем изделиям наших ___ боги наши.
cases.translation: We will not say to the work of our hands.
In you the fatherless find mercy.
I will be like dew to Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: He will be beautiful as a tree.
The righteous will walk in the ways.
cases.explain: The preposition по (along) governs the dative case.

reading.ru: Народ Самарии должен понести свое наказание, потому что он восстал против своего Бога.
reading.question: Why must Samaria bear punishment?
reading.explain: The text says: восстал против своего Бога — rebelled against their God.

reading.ru: Они падут от меча, их дети будут разорваны на куски.
reading.question: What judgment comes?
options: They will fall by sword, children torn apart
reading.correct: They will fall by sword, children torn apart
reading.explain: The passage says: падут от меча, дети будут разорваны — they will fall by sword, children will be torn.

reading.ru: Вернись, Израиль, к Господу своему Богу. Твои грехи были твоим падением.
reading.question: What is Israel called to do?
options: Return to the Lord their God
reading.correct: Return to the Lord their God
reading.explain: God calls: Вернись, Израиль, к Господу — Return, Israel, to the Lord.

reading.ru: Я исцелю их неверность и изберу любовь к ним.
reading.question: What does the Lord say He will do?
options: Heal their unfaithfulness and love them
reading.correct: Heal their unfaithfulness and love them
reading.explain: God declares: исцелю их неверность и изберу любовь — I will heal their waywardness and love them.

reading.ru: Я буду росой для Израиля, и он расцветет, как лилия.
reading.question: How will God sustain Israel?
options: He will be dew to Israel who will bloom like lily
reading.correct: He will be dew to Israel who will bloom like lily
reading.explain: God says: буду росой... расцветет, как лилия — I will be dew and he will blossom like the lily.

reading.ru: Тот, кто мудр, уразумеет эти вещи.
reading.question: What is the concluding call?
options: The wise will understand these things
reading.correct: The wise will understand these things
reading.explain: The text says: Тот, кто мудр, уразумеет — He who is wise will understand.
